rows.text: The key to piloting Kuja, Genome Sorcerer is understanding its core engine: Kuja generates Wizard tokens at end step that ping every opponent whenever you cast a noncreature spell. Once you control four Wizards, Kuja transforms into Trance Kuja, doubling all damage dealt by Wizards to burn out the table in rapid storm turns.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Demonic Tutor, Jeska's Will, Bolas's Citadel. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
